DLF Purseni Club — Jali Screen (2018).

A jali is a pierced ornamental screen that filters light and air while it decorates. For the members' club at DLF Purseni, the brief was a single ornamental language for every partition and façade screen — so this is less a logo than a system: one tile that repeats forever.

An eight-point star locks with a cross to fill the plane with no seams, drawn once as scalable vector so it could be cut at any size and still read as one pattern.

Environmental design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·76.
